name: std::ranges::adjacent_view<V,N>::iterator<Const>::operator*
intro:
Returns the elements into V the underlying array of iterators points to.

Let current_ be an underlying array of iterators.

Equivalent to:

return /*tuple-transform*/([](auto& i) -> decltype(auto) { return *i; }, current_);

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The current element, which is a std::tuple of references to underlying elements.

summary: Returns the elements into V the underlying array of iterators points to.
